title: Onet
description: A compact O*NET reference at packages/naive/src/functions/onet.json (EE-232): every occupation of one O*NET database release by its O*NET-SOC code and title, the detailed work activities (DWAs) of that release, and for each occupation the DWAs its task statements link to. It is what Naive needs to suggest occupations for a PCF element no role answers for, and nothing more: no descriptions, task statements, ratings or other O*NET content. O*NET is licensed under CC BY 4.0, so the file carries the attribution O*NET asks for. Written by scripts/import-onet.ts; an empty reference (no occupations and no DWAs) is valid and means no release was imported.

release.description: The O*NET database release, such as 31.0.

published.description: The year and month the release was published, from its Read Me.txt when the import found one.

attribution.description: The attribution O*NET's CC BY 4.0 licence asks for in every copy and derivative work, naming the release.

dwas.description: Every detailed work activity of the release, sorted by element id.

id.description: The DWA's O*NET element id, such as 4.A.2.a.4.i.3.

title.description: The DWA's name, verbatim from O*NET.

occupations.description: Every occupation of the release, sorted by code.

title.description: The occupation's title, verbatim from O*NET.

dwas.description: The DWAs the occupation's task statements link to, by element id, sorted. Empty for an occupation O*NET gives no tasks.
